item.bloodrunes.blank_rune.desc:
§7A stone most barren, thirsting for noble blood.§r
§8Lay it upon the Runic Anvil to commence thy rite.§r
item.bloodrunes.blood_rune.desc:
§7Imbued with the primeval vigour of the beast.§r
§8Draweth forth the life-blood of thine adversaries.§r
item.bloodrunes.courage_rune.desc:
§7Forg'd in the direst peril of mortall combat.§r
§8Smiteth harder when death knocketh at thy door.§r
message.bloodrunes.language_learned: Thou hast decipher'd the ancient tongue of the Northmen!
message.bloodrunes.unknown_language: Thou lackest comprehension of these ancient runes to fashion this relic.
message.bloodrunes.ritual_started: The altar hummeth with foul and ancient sorcery...
message.bloodrunes.ritual_success: The rite hath reached its glorious fruition!
item.bloodrunes.fehu_rune.desc:
§7Token of wealth and fair fortune.§r
§8Show'reth the bearer with gold and spoils.§r
item.bloodrunes.uruz_rune.desc:
§7Vigour of the ancient wild beast.§r
§8Granteth stout health and brawn.§r
item.bloodrunes.thurisaz_rune.desc:
§7Ruinous wrath of the giants.§r
§8Casteth blows back upon the assailant.§r
item.bloodrunes.ansuz_rune.desc:
§7Divine knowledge of Odin All-Father.§r
§8Heighteneth sorcery and arcane lore.§r
item.bloodrunes.raido_rune.desc:
§7Wandering under the canopy of stars.§r
§8Speedeth thy gait and wardeth thy path.§r
item.bloodrunes.kenaz_rune.desc:
§7Promethean flame and sacred fire.§r
§8Bestoweth flaming blades in combat.§r
item.bloodrunes.gebo_rune.desc:
§7Sacred pledge and gentle bond.§r
§8Knitteth the souls of comrades-in-arms.§r
item.bloodrunes.wunjo_rune.desc:
§7Delight, merriment, and song.§r
§8Bindeth wounds and cheereth the host.§r
item.bloodrunes.hagalaz_rune.desc:
§7A tempest most violent.§r
§8Calleth down Jove's thunder from high.§r
item.bloodrunes.nauthiz_rune.desc:
§7The beacon of despair.§r
§8Awakeneth superhuman fury when near death.§r
item.bloodrunes.isa_rune.desc:
§7The primeval frost of Niflheim.§r
§8Freezeth thy foes into still marble.§r
item.bloodrunes.jera_rune.desc:
§7The turning wheel of seasons.§r
§8Rewardeth the patient husbandman.§r
item.bloodrunes.eihwaz_rune.desc:
§7Bridge connecting life and grave.§r
§8Sucketh the marrow and spirit of foes.§r
item.bloodrunes.perthro_rune.desc:
§7The casting of the fatal lot.§r
§8Wondrous fortune at perilous hazard.§r
item.bloodrunes.algiz_rune.desc:
§7The shield of the heavenly host.§r
§8Yieldeth an impenetrable defence.§r
item.bloodrunes.sowilo_rune.desc:
§7Splendour of the high sun.§r
§8Purgeth the restless dead with light.§r
item.bloodrunes.tiwaz_rune.desc:
§7Tyr's solemn pledge of honour.§r
§8Pierceth all armour at cost of defence.§r
item.bloodrunes.berkano_rune.desc:
§7Awakening from the sleep of death.§r
§8Granteth reprieve from the Ferryman.§r
item.bloodrunes.ehwaz_rune.desc:
§7Kinship with the noble courser.§r
§8Empowereth horse and horseman alike.§r
item.bloodrunes.mannaz_rune.desc:
§7Humanity's fellowship.§r
§8Inclineth the hearts of merchants unto thee.§r
item.bloodrunes.laguz_rune.desc:
§7The boundless watery deep.§r
§8Commandeth Neptune's stormy domain.§r
item.bloodrunes.ingwaz_rune.desc:
§7The seed of fertile soil.§r
§8Hasteth the growth of flock and field.§r
item.bloodrunes.dagaz_rune.desc:
§7Dawn's sudden revelation.§r
§8Translateth thy flesh through space.§r
item.bloodrunes.othala_rune.desc:
§7The hearth of thine ancestors.§r
§8Wardeth thy homestead against foes.§r
